method.band_balance: Autocorrelation after RMS balancing four fixed bands with an amplitude floor. The mean equally weights bands rather than allowing the loudest band to dominate.
method.baseline: Raw 40 ms autocorrelation, .78 peak and sustained in two-thirds of windows.
method.flank_whitening: Subtract a local power estimate from 40 ms window spectra using 200–400 ms of source context on each side. Preserve timing and search peaks using normalized autocorrelation.
method.mix: Original and alternate each use their own nominal -5 dB foreground-to-background RMS. Per source side, one common scale covers every delivery, including matched background-only controls.
method.review: Per arm, maximize valid recovery of clean-positive windows on development only, with no more than one added distinct background window and one added mixture without clean support. Prefer the larger cutoff on ties. Compare candidate unions with the current raw decision.
method.scope: First source pair per SINE reader, original and alternate. Four fixed 400 ms windows per delivery.
